item.title: World leaders meet in Philippines for ASEAN summit
item.description: Key Actors: Anthony Albanese, Donald Trump, Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, Philippines President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., Ahmed Al Ahmed, Sean Duffy Key Themes: ASEAN Summit addressing war, global instability, and energy security in Southeast Asia, Myanmar civil war with estimated 100,000 deaths amid ASEAN's failed resolution efforts, South China Sea territorial disputes and China's nine-dash line claim, US nationwide flight grounding blamed on outdated air traffic control system requiring $50 billion in funding, Australian government's proposed gas reservation scheme facing Senate opposition from Coalition and Greens, Microsoft outage exploited by cybercriminals for phishing scams and ransomware attacks, One-year anniversary of Bondi terror attack with hero Ahmed Al Ahmed still suffering permanent injuries, NASA's Voyager One probe reaches one light day distance from Earth after 49 years in space
